entries.heading: Unspecified
entries.note: <Product> is related to <RelatedProduct> in a way that cannot be specified by another code value

entries.heading: Includes
entries.note: <Product> includes <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 02)

entries.heading: Is part of
entries.note: <Product> is part of <RelatedProduct>: use for ‘also available as part of’ (inverse of code 01)

entries.heading: Replaces
entries.note: <Product> replaces, or is new edition of, <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 05)

entries.heading: Has companion product
entries.note: <Product> and <RelatedProduct> are companion products, intended to be used, or are usable, together (is own inverse). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Replaced by
entries.note: <Product> is replaced by, or has new edition, <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 03)

entries.heading: Alternative format
entries.note: <Product> is available in an alternative format as <RelatedProduct> – indicates an alternative format of the same content which is or may be available (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Has ancillary product
entries.note: <Product> has an ancillary or supplementary product <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 08)

entries.heading: Is ancillary to
entries.note: <Product> is ancillary or supplementary to <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 07)

entries.heading: Is remaindered as
entries.note: <Product> is remaindered as <RelatedProduct>, when a remainder merchant assigns its own identifier to the product (inverse of code 10)

entries.heading: Is remainder of
entries.note: <Product> was originally sold as <RelatedProduct>, indicating the publisher’s original identifier for a title which is offered as a remainder under a different identifier (inverse of code 09)

entries.heading: Is other-language version of
entries.note: <Product> is an other-language version of <RelatedProduct> (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Publisher’s suggested alternative
entries.note: <Product> has a publisher’s suggested alternative <RelatedProduct>, which does not, however, carry the same content (cf 05 and 06)

entries.heading: Epublication based on (print product)
entries.note: <Product> is an epublication based on printed product <RelatedProduct>. The related product is the source of any print-equivalent page numbering present in the epublication (inverse of code 27)

entries.heading: POD replacement for
entries.note: <Product> is a POD replacement for <RelatedProduct>. <RelatedProduct> is an out-of-print product replaced by a print-on-demand version under a new ISBN (inverse of code 17)

entries.heading: Replaced by POD
entries.note: <Product> is replaced by POD <RelatedProduct>. <RelatedProduct> is a print-on-demand replacement, under a new ISBN, for an out-of-print <Product> (inverse of code 16)

entries.heading: Is special edition of
entries.note: <Product> is a special edition of <RelatedProduct>. Used for a special edition (de: ‘Sonderausgabe’) with different cover, binding, premium content etc – more than ‘alternative format’ – which may be available in limited quantity and for a limited time (inverse of code 19)

entries.heading: Has special edition
entries.note: <Product> has a special edition <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 18)

entries.heading: Is prebound edition of
entries.note: <Product> is a prebound edition of <RelatedProduct> (In the US, a ‘prebound’ edition is ‘a book that was previously bound and has been rebound with a library quality hardcover binding. In almost all commercial cases, the book in question began as a paperback. This might also be termed ‘re-bound’) (inverse of code 21)

entries.heading: Is original of prebound edition
entries.note: <Product> is the regular edition of which <RelatedProduct> is a prebound edition (inverse of code 20)

entries.heading: Product by same author
entries.note: <Product> and <RelatedProduct> have a common author

entries.heading: Similar product
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is another product that is suggested as similar to <Product> (‘if you liked <Product>, you may also like <RelatedProduct>’, or vice versa). In some markets, this may be termed a ‘comparison title’ or ‘comp title’

entries.heading: Is facsimile of
entries.note: <Product> is a facsimile edition of <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 25)

entries.heading: Is original of facsimile
entries.note: <Product> is the original edition from which a facsimile edition <RelatedProduct> is taken (inverse of code 24)

entries.heading: Is license for
entries.note: <Product> is a license for a digital <RelatedProduct>, traded or supplied separately

entries.heading: Electronic version available as
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is an electronic version of print <Product> (inverse of code 13)

entries.heading: Enhanced version available as
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is an ‘enhanced’ version of <Product>, with additional content. Typically used to link an enhanced e-book to its original ‘unenhanced’ equivalent, but not specifically limited to linking e-books – for example, may be used to link non-illustrated and illustrated print books, original and enlarged editions etc. <Product> and <RelatedProduct> should share the same <ProductForm> (inverse of code 29)

entries.heading: Basic version available as
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is a basic version of <Product>. <Product> and <RelatedProduct> should share the same <ProductForm> (inverse of code 28)

entries.heading: Product in same collection
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> and <Product> are part of the same collection (eg two products in same series or set, whether ordered or unordered) (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Has alternative in a different market sector
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is an alternative product in another sector (of the same geographical market). Indicates an alternative that carries the same content, but available to a different set of customers, as one or both products are retailer-, channel- or market sector-specific (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Has equivalent intended for a different market
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is an equivalent product, often intended for another (geographical) market. Indicates an alternative that carries essentially the same content, though slightly adapted for local circumstances (as opposed to a translation – use code 11) (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Has alternative intended for different market
entries.note: <RelatedProduct> is an alternative product, often intended for another (geographical) market. Indicates the content of the alternative is identical in all respects (is own inverse)

entries.heading: Cites
entries.note: <Product> cites <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 35)

entries.heading: Is cited by
entries.note: <Product> is the object of a citation in <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 34)

entries.heading: Is signed version of
entries.note: <Product> is a signed copy of <RelatedProduct>. Use where signed copies are given a distinct product identifier and can be ordered separately, but are otherwise identical (inverse of code 38)

entries.heading: Has signed version
entries.note: <Product> is an unsigned copy of <RelatedProduct>. Use where signed copies are given a distinct product identifier and can be ordered separately, but are otherwise identical (inverse of code 37)

entries.heading: Has related student material
entries.note: <Product> is intended for teacher use, and the related product is for student use

entries.heading: Has related teacher material
entries.note: <Product> is intended for student use, and the related product is for teacher use

entries.heading: Some content shared with
entries.note: <Product> includes some content shared with <RelatedProduct>. Note the shared content does not form the whole of either product. Compare with the ‘includes’ / ‘is part of’ relationship pair (codes 01 and 02), where the shared content forms the whole of one of the products, and with the ‘alternative format’ relationship (code 06), where the shared content forms the whole of both products (code 41 is own inverse)

entries.heading: Is later edition of first edition
entries.note: <Product> is a later edition of <RelatedProduct>, where the related product is the first edition

entries.heading: Adapted from
entries.note: <Product> is an adapted (dramatized, abridged, novelized etc) version of <RelatedProduct> (inverse of code 44). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Adapted as
entries.note: <Product> is the original from which <RelatedProduct> is adapted (dramatized etc) (inverse of code 43). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Has linked product offer
entries.note: Purchases of <Product> may qualify for one or more copies of <RelatedProduct> either free of charge or at a reduced price (inverse of code 48). This may be dependent on retailer participation, upon price and upon the quantity of the <Product> purchased. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: May be substituted by
entries.note: If ordered, <Product> may (at the supplier’s discretion) be substituted and the <RelatedProduct> supplied instead (inverse of code 47). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: May be substituted for
entries.note: If ordered, <RelatedProduct> may (at the supplier’s discretion) be substituted and the <Product> supplied instead (inverse of code 46). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Is linked product offer
entries.note: Purchases of <RelatedProduct> may qualify for one or more copies of <Product> either free of charge or at a reduced price (inverse of code 45). This may be dependent on retailer participation, upon price and upon the quantity of the <RelatedProduct> purchased. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Proprietary returns coding scheme
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <ReturnsCodeTypeName> is required with proprietary coding schemes. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: French book trade returns conditions code
entries.note: Maintained by CLIL (Commission Interprofessionnel du Livre). Returns conditions values in <ReturnsCode> should be taken from the CLIL list

entries.heading: BISAC Returnable Indicator code
entries.note: Maintained by BISAC: Returns conditions values in <ReturnsCode> should be taken from List 66

entries.heading: UK book trade returns conditions code
entries.note: NOT CURRENTLY USED – BIC has decided that it will not maintain a code list for this purpose, since returns conditions are usually at least partly based on the trading relationship

entries.heading: ONIX Returns conditions code
entries.note: Returns conditions values in <ReturnsCode> should be taken from List 204

entries.heading: YYYYMMDD
entries.note: Common Era year, month and day (default for most dates)

entries.heading: YYYYMM
entries.note: Year and month

entries.heading: YYYYWW
entries.note: Year and week number

entries.heading: YYYYQ
entries.note: Year and quarter (Q = 1, 2, 3, 4, with 1 = Jan to Mar)

entries.heading: YYYYS
entries.note: Year and season (S = 1, 2, 3, 4, with 1 = ‘Spring’)

entries.heading: YYYY
entries.note: Year (default for some dates)

entries.heading: YYYYMMDDYYYYMMDD
entries.note: Spread of exact dates

entries.heading: YYYYMMYYYYMM
entries.note: Spread of months

entries.heading: YYYYWWYYYYWW
entries.note: Spread of week numbers

entries.heading: YYYYQYYYYQ
entries.note: Spread of quarters

entries.heading: YYYYSYYYYS
entries.note: Spread of seasons

entries.heading: YYYYYYYY
entries.note: Spread of years

entries.heading: Text string
entries.note: For complex, approximate or uncertain dates, or dates BCE. Suggested maximum length 100 characters

entries.heading: YYYYMMDDThhmm
entries.note: Exact time. Use ONLY when exact times with hour / minute precision are relevant. By default, time is local. Alternatively, the time may be suffixed with an optional ‘Z’ for UTC times, or with ‘+’ or ‘-’ and an hhmm timezone offset from UTC. Times without a timezone are ‘rolling’ local times, times qualified with a timezone (using Z, + or -) specify a particular instant in time

entries.heading: YYYYMMDDThhmmss
entries.note: Exact time. Use ONLY when exact times with second precision are relevant. By default, time is local. Alternatively, the time may be suffixed with an optional ‘Z’ for UTC times, or with ‘+’ or ‘-’ and an hhmm timezone offset from UTC. Times without a timezone are ‘rolling’ local times, times qualified with a timezone (using Z, + or -) specify a particular instant in time

entries.heading: YYYYMMDD (H)
entries.note: Year month day (Hijri calendar)

entries.heading: YYYYMM (H)
entries.note: Year and month (Hijri calendar)

entries.heading: YYYY (H)
entries.note: Year (Hijri calendar)

entries.heading: Text string (H)
entries.note: For complex, approximate or uncertain dates (Hijri calendar), text would usually be in Arabic script. Suggested maximum length 100 characters

entries.heading: Not sold separately
entries.note: Not sold separately at retail

entries.heading: Contact supplier
entries.note: May be used for books that do not carry a recommended retail price; when goods can only be ordered ‘in person’ from a sales representative; when an ONIX file is ‘broadcast’ rather than sent one-to-one to a single trading partner; or for digital products offered on subscription or with pricing which is too complex to specify in ONIX

entries.heading: Not sold as set
entries.note: When a collection that is not sold as a set nevertheless has its own ONIX record

entries.heading: Revenue share
entries.note: Unpriced, but available via a pre-determined revenue share agreement

entries.heading: Calculated from contents
entries.note: Price calculated as sum of individual prices of components listed as Product parts. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Supplier does not supply
entries.note: The supplier does not operate, or does not offer this product, in this part of the market as indicated by <Territory>. Use when other prices apply in different parts of the market (eg when the market is global, but the particular supplier does not operate outside its domestic territory). Use code 04 when the supplier does supply but has not set a price for part of the market. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: RRP excluding tax
entries.note: Recommended Retail Price, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Price recommended by the publisher or supplier for retail sales to the consumer. Also termed the Suggested Retail Price (SRP) or Maximum Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) in some countries. The retailer may choose to use this recommended price, or may choose to sell to the consumer at a lower (or occasionally, a higher) price which is termed the Actual Selling Price (ASP) in sales reports. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the RRP minus a trade discount (which may be customer-specific). Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

entries.heading: RRP including tax
entries.note: Recommended Retail Price, including sales or value-added tax where applicable. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the trade discount. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

entries.heading: FRP excluding tax
entries.note: Fixed Retail Price, excluding any sales or value-added tax, used in countries where retail price maintenance applies (by law or via trade agreement) to certain products. Price fixed by the publisher or supplier for retail sales to the consumer. The retailer must use this price, or may vary the price only within certain legally-prescribed limits. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the FRP minus a customer-specific trade discount. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

entries.heading: FRP including tax
entries.note: Fixed Retail Price, including any sales or value-added tax where applicable, used in countries where retail price maintenance applies (by law or via trade agreement) to certain products. The net price charged to the retailer depends on the trade discount. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

entries.heading: Supplier’s Net price excluding tax
entries.note: Net or wholesale price, excluding any sales or value-added tax. Unit price charged by supplier for business-to-business transactions, without any direct relationship to the price for retail sales to the consumer, but sometimes subject to a further customer-specific trade discount based on volume. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient

entries.heading: Supplier’s Net price excluding tax: rental goods
entries.note: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller / rental outlet, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax: goods for rental (used for video and DVD)

entries.heading: Supplier’s Net price including tax
entries.note: Net or wholesale price, including any sales or value-added tax where applicable. Unit price charged by supplier for business-to-business transactions, without any direct relationship to the price for retail sales to the consumer, but sometimes subject to a further customer-specific trade discount based on volume. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite

entries.heading: Supplier’s alternative Net price excluding tax
entries.note: Net or wholesale price charged by supplier to a specified class of reseller, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Relevant tax detail must be calculated by the data recipient. (This value is for use only in countries, eg Finland, where trade practice requires two different Net prices to be listed for different classes of resellers, and where national guidelines specify how the code should be used)

entries.heading: Supplier’s alternative net price including tax
entries.note: Net or wholesale price charged by supplier to a specified class of reseller, including any sales tax or value-added tax. Sales or value-added tax detail is usually supplied in the <Tax> composite. (This value is for use only in countries, eg Finland, where trade practice requires two different Net prices to be listed for different classes of resellers, and where national guidelines specify how the code should be used)

entries.heading: Special sale RRP excluding tax
entries.note: Special sale RRP excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Note ‘special sales’ are sales where terms and conditions are different from normal trade sales, when for example products that are normally sold on a sale-or-return basis are sold on firm-sale terms, where a particular product is tailored for a specific retail outlet (often termed a ‘premium’ product), or where other specific conditions or qualifications apply. Further details of the modified terms and conditions should be given in <PriceTypeDescription>

entries.heading: Special sale RRP including tax
entries.note: Special sale RRP including sales or value-added tax if applicable

entries.heading: Special sale fixed retail price excluding tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

entries.heading: Special sale fixed retail price including tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

entries.heading: Supplier’s net price for special sale excluding tax
entries.note: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller for special sale excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

entries.heading: Supplier’s net price for special sale including tax
entries.note: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller for special sale including any sales tax or value-added tax

entries.heading: Pre-publication RRP excluding tax
entries.note: Pre-publication RRP excluding any sales tax or value-added tax. Use where RRP for pre-orders is different from post-publication RRP

entries.heading: Pre-publication RRP including tax
entries.note: Pre-publication RRP including sales or value-added tax if applicable. Use where RRP for pre-orders is different from post-publication RRP

entries.heading: Pre-publication fixed retail price excluding tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

entries.heading: Pre-publication fixed retail price including tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products: not used in USA

entries.heading: Supplier’s pre-publication net price excluding tax
entries.note: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller pre-publication excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

entries.heading: Supplier’s pre-publication net price including tax
entries.note: Unit price charged by supplier to reseller pre-publication including any sales tax or value-added tax

entries.heading: Freight-pass-through RRP excluding tax
entries.note: In the US, books are sometimes supplied on ‘freight-pass-through’ terms, where a price that is different from the RRP is used as the basis for calculating the supplier’s charge to a reseller. To make it clear when such terms are being invoked, code 31 is used instead of code 01 to indicate the RRP. Code 32 is used for the ‘billing price’

entries.heading: Freight-pass-through billing price excluding tax
entries.note: When freight-pass-through terms apply, the price on which the supplier’s charge to a reseller is calculated, ie the price to which trade discount terms are applied. See also code 31

entries.heading: Importer’s Fixed retail price excluding tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products, but the price is set by the importer or local sales agent, not the foreign publisher. In France, ‘prix catalogue éditeur étranger’

entries.heading: Importer’s Fixed retail price including tax
entries.note: In countries where retail price maintenance applies by law to certain products, but the price is set by the importer or local sales agent, not the foreign publisher. In France, ‘prix catalogue éditeur étranger’

entries.heading: Nominal gratis copy value for customs purposes, excluding tax
entries.note: Nominal value of gratis copies (eg review, sample or evaluation copies) for international customs declarations only, when a ‘free of charge’ price cannot be used. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Nominal value for claims purposes, excluding tax
entries.note: Nominal value of copies for claims purposes only (eg to account for copies lost during distribution). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Nominal value for customs purposes, excluding tax
entries.note: Nominal value of copies (Declared Unit Value) for international customs declarations only. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Publishers retail price excluding tax
entries.note: For a product supplied on agency terms, the retail price set by the publisher, excluding any sales tax or value-added tax

entries.heading: Publishers retail price including tax
entries.note: For a product supplied on agency terms, the retail price set by the publisher, including sales or value-added tax if applicable

entries.heading: Unqualified price
entries.note: Price applies to all customers that do not fall within any other group with a specified group-specific qualified price

entries.heading: Member / subscriber price
entries.note: Price applies to a designated group membership

entries.heading: Export price
entries.note: Price applies to sales outside the territory in which the supplier is located

entries.heading: Reduced price applicable when the item is purchased as part of a set (or series, or collection)
entries.note: Use in cases where there is no combined price, but a lower price is offered for each part if the whole set / series / collection is purchased (either at one time, as part of a continuing commitment, or in a single purchase)

entries.heading: Voucher price
entries.note: In the Netherlands (or any other market where similar arrangements exist): a reduced fixed price available for a limited time on presentation of a voucher or coupon published in a specified medium, eg a newspaper. Should be accompanied by Price Type code 13 and additional detail in <PriceTypeDescription>, and by validity dates in <PriceEffectiveFrom> and <PriceEffectiveUntil> (ONIX 2.1) or in the <PriceDate> composite (ONIX 3.0 or later)

entries.heading: Consumer price
entries.note: Price for individual consumer sale only

entries.heading: Corporate / Library / Education price
entries.note: Price for sale to libraries or other corporate or institutional customers

entries.heading: Reservation order price
entries.note: Price valid for a specified period prior to publication. Orders placed prior to the end of the period are guaranteed to be delivered to the retailer before the nominal publication date. The price may or may not be different from the ‘normal’ price, which carries no such delivery guarantee. Must be accompanied by a <PriceEffectiveUntil> date (or equivalent <PriceDate> composite in ONIX 3.0 or later), and should also be accompanied by a ‘normal’ price

entries.heading: Promotional offer price
entries.note: Temporary ‘Special offer’ price. Must be accompanied by <PriceEffectiveFrom> and <PriceEffectiveUntil> dates (or equivalent <PriceDate> composites in ONIX 3.0 or later), and may also be accompanied by a ‘normal’ price

entries.heading: Linked price
entries.note: Price requires purchase with, or proof of ownership of another product. Further details of purchase or ownership requirements must be given in <PriceTypeDescription>

entries.heading: Library price
entries.note: Price for sale only to libraries (including public, school and academic libraries)

entries.heading: Education price
entries.note: Price for sale only to educational institutions (including school and academic libraries), educational buying consortia, government and local government bodies purchasing for use in education

entries.heading: Corporate price
entries.note: Price for sale to corporate customers only

entries.heading: Subscription service price
entries.note: Price for sale to organizations or services offering consumers subscription access to a library of books

entries.heading: School library price
entries.note: Price for primary and secondary education

entries.heading: Academic library price
entries.note: Price for higher education and scholarly institutions

entries.heading: Introductory price
entries.note: Initial ‘Introductory offer’ price. Must be accompanied by an Effective until date in a <PriceDate> composite in ONIX 3, and may also be accompanied by a ‘normal’ price valid after the introductory offer expires (Fr. Prix de lancement). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Consortial price
entries.note: Price for library consortia. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Education price for alternative provision
entries.note: (fr: « prix pour l’education specialisée ») Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Per copy of whole product
entries.note: Default. Note where the product is a pack of multiple copies, the price is per multi-item product, not per individual copy within the pack

entries.heading: Per page for printed loose-leaf content only
Unspecified
entries.note: Default

entries.heading: Higher rate
entries.note: Specifies that tax is applied at a higher rate than standard

entries.heading: Tax paid at source (Italy)
entries.note: Under Italian tax rules, VAT on books may be paid at source by the publisher, and subsequent transactions through the supply chain are tax-exempt

entries.heading: Lower rate
entries.note: Specifies that tax is applied at a lower rate than standard. In the EU, use code R for ‘Reduced rates’, and for rates lower than 5%, use code T (‘Super-reduced’) or Z (Zero-rated)

entries.heading: Super-low rate
entries.note: Specifies that tax is applied at a rate lower than the Lower rate(s). In the EU, use code T for ‘Super-reduced rates’, and for Reduced rates (5% or above) use code R (Lower rate). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Unspecified
entries.note: Status is not specified (as distinct from unknown): the default if the <PublishingStatus> element is not sent. Also to be used in applications where the element is considered mandatory, but the sender of the ONIX message chooses not to pass on status information

entries.heading: Cancelled
entries.note: The product was announced, and subsequently abandoned; the <PublicationDate> element in ONIX 2.1 or its equivalent in <PublishingDate> in ONIX 3.0 or later must not be sent

entries.heading: Forthcoming
entries.note: Not yet published; must be accompanied by the expected date in <PublicationDate> in ONIX 2.1, or its equivalent in the <PublishingDate> composite in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Postponed indefinitely
entries.note: The product was announced, and subsequently postponed with no expected publication date; the <PublicationDate> element in ONIX 2.1, or its equivalent as a <PublishingDate> composite in ONIX 3.0 or later, must not be sent

entries.heading: Active
entries.note: The product was published, and is still active in the sense that the publisher will accept orders for it, though it may or may not be immediately available, for which see <SupplyDetail>

entries.heading: No longer our product
entries.note: Ownership of the product has been transferred to another publisher (with details of acquiring publisher if possible in PR.19 (ONIX 2.1) OR P.19 (ONIX 3.0 or later))

entries.heading: Out of stock indefinitely
entries.note: The product was active, but is now inactive in the sense that (a) the publisher cannot fulfill orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) there are no current plans to bring it back into stock. Use this code for ‘reprint under consideration’. Code 06 does not specifically imply that returns are or are not still accepted

entries.heading: Out of print
entries.note: The product was active, but is now permanently inactive in the sense that (a) the publisher will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) the product will not be made available again under the same ISBN. Code 07 normally implies that the publisher will not accept returns beyond a specified date

entries.heading: Inactive
entries.note: The product was active, but is now permanently or indefinitely inactive in the sense that the publisher will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain. Code 08 covers both of codes 06 and 07, and may be used where the distinction between those values is either unnecessary or meaningless

entries.heading: Unknown
entries.note: The sender of the ONIX record does not know the current publishing status

entries.heading: Remaindered
entries.note: The product is no longer available from the current publisher, under the current ISBN, at the current price. It may be available to be traded through another channel. A Publishing Status code 10 ‘Remaindered’ usually but not always means that the publisher has decided to sell off excess inventory of the book. Copies of books that are remaindered are often made available in the supply chain at a reduced price. However, such remainders are often sold under a product identifier that differs from the ISBN on the full-priced copy of the book. A Publishing Status code 10 ‘Remaindered’ on a given product record may or may not be followed by a Publishing Status code 06 ‘Out of Stock Indefinitely’ or 07 ‘Out of Print’: the practice varies from one publisher to another. Some publishers may revert to a Publishing Status code 04 ‘Active’ if a desired inventory level on the product in question has subsequently been reached. No change in rights should ever be inferred from this (or any other) Publishing Status code value

entries.heading: Withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Withdrawn, typically for legal reasons or to avoid giving offence

entries.heading: Recalled
entries.note: Recalled for reasons of consumer safety. Deprecated, use code 15 instead

entries.heading: Active, but not sold separately
entries.note: The product is published and active but, as a publishing decision, its constituent parts are not sold separately – only in an assembly or as part of a pack, eg with Product composition code 01. Also use with Product composition codes 30, 31 where depending on product composition and pricing, items in the pack may or may not be saleable separately at retail

entries.heading: Recalled
entries.note: Recalled for reasons of consumer safety

entries.heading: Temporarily withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Withdrawn temporarily, typically for quality or technical reasons. In ONIX 3.0 or later, must be accompanied by expected availability date coded ‘22’ within the <PublishingDate> composite, except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known

entries.heading: Permanently withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Withdrawn permanently from sale in all markets. Effectively synonymous with ‘Out of print’ (code 07), but specific to downloadable and online digital products (where no ‘stock’ would remain in the supply chain)

entries.heading: Active, but not sold as set
entries.note: The various constituent parts of a product are published and active but, as a publishing decision, they are not sold together as a single product – eg with Product composition code 11 – and are only available as a number of individual items. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Cancelled
entries.note: Product was announced, and subsequently abandoned by the publisher. No expected availability date should be included in <SupplyDate>

entries.heading: Not yet available, postponed indefinitely
entries.note: Product is not yet available from the supplier, and the publisher indicates that it has been postponed indefinitely. Should be used in preference to code 10 where the publisher has indicated that a previously-announced publication date is no longer correct, and no new date has yet been announced. No expected availability date should be included in <SupplyDate>. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Not yet available
entries.note: Product is not yet available (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

entries.heading: Awaiting stock
entries.note: Product is not yet available, but will be a stock item when available (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known). Used particularly for imports which have been published in the country of origin but have not yet arrived in the importing country

entries.heading: Not yet available, will be POD
entries.note: Product is not yet available, to be published as print-on-demand only (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known). May apply either to a POD successor to an existing conventional edition, when the successor will be published under a different ISBN (normally because different trade terms apply); or to a title that is being published as a POD original

entries.heading: Available
entries.note: Product is available from the supplier (form of availability unspecified)

entries.heading: In stock
entries.note: Product is available from the supplier as a stock item

entries.heading: To order
entries.note: Product is available from the supplier as a non-stock item, by special order. Where possible, an <OrderTime> should be included

entries.heading: POD
entries.note: Product is available from the supplier by print-on-demand. If the fulfillment delay is likely to be more than 24 hours, an <OrderTime> should be included

entries.heading: Temporarily unavailable
entries.note: Product is temporarily unavailable: temporarily unavailable from the supplier (reason unspecified) (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

entries.heading: Out of stock
entries.note: Product is stock item, but is temporarily out of stock (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

entries.heading: Reprinting
entries.note: Product is temporarily unavailable, and is reprinting (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

entries.heading: Awaiting reissue
entries.note: Product is temporarily unavailable, awaiting reissue (requires expected date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known)

entries.heading: Temporarily withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Product is temporarily withdrawn from sale, possibly for quality or technical reasons. Requires expected availability date, either as <ExpectedShipDate> (ONIX 2.1) or as <SupplyDate> with <SupplyDateRole> coded ‘08’ (ONIX 3.0 or later), except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known

entries.heading: Not available (reason unspecified)
entries.note: Product is not available from the supplier (for any reason)

entries.heading: Not available, replaced by new product
entries.note: Product is unavailable, but a successor product or edition is or will be available from the supplier (identify successor in <RelatedProduct>)

entries.heading: Not available, other format available
entries.note: Product is unavailable, but the same content is or will be available from the supplier in an alternative format (identify other format product in <RelatedProduct>)

entries.heading: No longer supplied by the supplier
entries.note: Product is no longer available from the supplier. Identify new supplier in <NewSupplier> if possible

entries.heading: Apply direct
entries.note: Product is not available to trade, apply direct to publisher

entries.heading: Not sold separately
entries.note: Product must be bought as part of a set or trade pack (identify set or pack in <RelatedProduct> using code 02). Individual copies of the product are not available from the supplier, but packs of copies are available, and individual copies of the product may typically be sold at retail

entries.heading: Withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Product is withdrawn from sale, possibly permanently. May be for legal reasons or to avoid giving offence

entries.heading: Remaindered
entries.note: Product has been remaindered and is no longer available from the supplier in the normal way, but may be available under different terms and conditions in order to dispose of excess stock

entries.heading: Not available, replaced by POD
entries.note: Product is out of print, but a print-on-demand edition is or will be available under a different ISBN. Use only when the POD successor has a different ISBN, normally because different trade terms apply

entries.heading: Recalled
entries.note: Product has been recalled, possibly for reasons of consumer safety

entries.heading: Not sold as set
entries.note: Contents of set or pack must be bought as individual items (identify contents of set or pack in <RelatedProduct> using code 01). Used when a collection that is not sold as a set nevertheless has its own ONIX record

entries.heading: Not available, publisher indicates OP
entries.note: Product is unavailable from the supplier, no successor product or alternative format is available or planned. Use this code only when the publisher has indicated the product is out of print

entries.heading: Not available, publisher no longer sells product in this market
entries.note: Product is unavailable from the supplier in this market, no successor product or alternative format is available or planned. Use this code when a publisher has indicated the product is permanently unavailable (in this market) while remaining available elsewhere

entries.heading: No recent update received
entries.note: Sender has not received any recent update for this product from the publisher or supplier (for use when the sender is a data aggregator). The definition of ‘recent’ must be specified by the aggregator, or by agreement between parties to an exchange

entries.heading: No longer receiving updates
entries.note: Sender is no longer receiving any updates from the publisher or supplier of this product (for use when the sender is a data aggregator)

entries.heading: Contact supplier
entries.note: Product availability not known to sender

entries.heading: Yes, returnable, stripped cover
entries.note: Note the product barcode should be repeated (with triangular ‘strippable’ indicator) on cover 2 (inside front cover) to facilitate scanning of returned stripped covers

entries.heading: Conditional
entries.note: Contact publisher for requirements and/or authorization

entries.heading: Unspecified
entries.note: Status is not specified (as distinct from unknown): the default if the <MarketPublishingStatus> element is not sent

entries.heading: Cancelled
entries.note: The product was announced for publication in this market, and subsequently abandoned. A market publication date must not be sent

entries.heading: Forthcoming
entries.note: Not yet published in this market, should be accompanied by expected local publication date

entries.heading: Postponed indefinitely
entries.note: The product was announced for publication in this market, and subsequently postponed with no expected local publication date. A market publication date must not be sent

entries.heading: Active
entries.note: The product was published in this market, and is still active in the sense that the publisher will accept orders for it, though it may or may not be immediately available, for which see <SupplyDetail>

entries.heading: No longer our product
entries.note: Responsibility for the product in this market has been transferred elsewhere (with details of acquiring publisher representative in this market if possible in PR.25 (in ONIX 2.1) OR P.25 (in ONIX 3.0 or later))

entries.heading: Out of stock indefinitely
entries.note: The product was active in this market, but is now inactive in the sense that (a) the publisher representative (local publisher or sales agent) cannot fulfill orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) there are no current plans to bring it back into stock in this market. Code 06 does not specifically imply that returns are or are not still accepted

entries.heading: Out of print
entries.note: The product was active in this market, but is now permanently inactive in this market in the sense that (a) the publisher representative (local publisher or sales agent) will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain, and (b) the product will not be made available again in this market under the same ISBN. Code 07 normally implies that the publisher will not accept returns beyond a specified date

entries.heading: Inactive
entries.note: The product was active in this market, but is now permanently or indefinitely inactive in the sense that the publisher representative (local publisher or sales agent) will not accept orders for it, though stock may still be available elsewhere in the supply chain. Code 08 covers both of codes 06 and 07, and may be used where the distinction between those values is either unnecessary or meaningless

entries.heading: Unknown
entries.note: The sender of the ONIX record does not know the current publishing status in this market

entries.heading: Remaindered
entries.note: The product is no longer available in this market from the publisher representative (local publisher or sales agent), under the current ISBN, at the current price. It may be available to be traded through another channel, usually at a reduced price

entries.heading: Withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Withdrawn from sale in this market, typically for legal reasons or to avoid giving offence

entries.heading: Not available in this market
entries.note: Either no rights are held for the product in this market, or for other reasons the publisher has decided not to make it available in this market

entries.heading: Active, but not sold separately
entries.note: The product is published and active in this market but, as a publishing decision, its constituent parts are not sold separately – only in an assembly or as part of a pack, eg with Product composition code 01. Also use with Product composition codes 30, 31 where depending on product composition and pricing, items in the pack may be saleable separately at retail

entries.heading: Active, with market restrictions
entries.note: The product is published in this market and active, but is not available to all customer types, typically because the market is split between exclusive sales agents for different market segments. In ONIX 2.1, should be accompanied by a free-text statement in <MarketRestrictionDetail> describing the nature of the restriction. In ONIX 3.0 or later, the <SalesRestriction> composite in Group P.24 should be used

entries.heading: Recalled
entries.note: Recalled in this market for reasons of consumer safety

entries.heading: Temporarily withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Temporarily withdrawn from sale in this market, typically for quality or technical reasons. In ONIX 3.0 or later, must be accompanied by expected availability date coded ‘22’ within the <MarketDate> composite, except in exceptional circumstances where no date is known

entries.heading: Permanently withdrawn from sale
entries.note: Withdrawn permanently from sale in this market. Effectively synonymous with ‘Out of print’ (code 07), but specific to downloadable and online digital products (where no ‘stock’ would remain in the supply chain). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Active, but not sold as set
entries.note: The various constituent parts of a product are published and active in this market but, as a publishing decision, they are not sold together as a single product – eg with Product composition code 11 – and are only available as a number of individual items. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Publisher acts as own sales agent
entries.note: Normally omitted, but required in some countries to provide positive indication the publisher acts as its own sales agent (FR: auto-diffuseur) in a specified market. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Exclusive sales agent
entries.note: Publisher’s exclusive sales agent in a specified territory

entries.heading: Non-exclusive sales agent
entries.note: Publisher’s non-exclusive sales agent in a specified territory

entries.heading: Local publisher
entries.note: Publisher for a specified territory

entries.heading: Sales agent
entries.note: Publisher’s sales agent in a specific territory. Use only where exclusive / non-exclusive status is not known. Prefer 05 or 06 as appropriate, where possible

entries.heading: Proprietary stock quantity coding scheme
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <StockQuantityCodeTypeName> is required with proprietary coding schemes

entries.heading: APA stock quantity code
entries.note: Code scheme defined by the Australian Publishers Association. Deprecated

entries.heading: Unspecified – see text
entries.note: Restriction must be described in <SalesRestrictionDetail> (ONIX 2.1) or <SalesRestrictionNote> (ONIX 3.0 or later)

entries.heading: Retailer exclusive / own brand
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales through designated retailer(s), which must be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite. Use only when it is not possible to assign the more explicit codes 04 or 05

entries.heading: Through office supplies outlets only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales though office supplies channels. Specific outlet(s) may be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite

entries.heading: Internal publisher use only: do not list
entries.note: For an ISBN that is assigned for a publisher’s internal purposes. Should not appear in ONIX messages sent externally, and if sent inadvertently, data recipients should not list the product in their catalogs

entries.heading: Retailer exclusive
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales (under the publisher’s brand / imprint) through the designated retailer(s), which must be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite

entries.heading: Retailer own brand
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales (under the retailer’s own brand / imprint) through the designated retailer(s), which must be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite

entries.heading: To libraries only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies to libraries (public and national libraries, libraries in educational institutions)

entries.heading: To schools only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies to schools (primary and secondary education)

entries.heading: Indiziert
entries.note: Indexed for the German market – in Deutschland indiziert

entries.heading: Except to libraries
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies other than to libraries

entries.heading: Through news outlets only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales though news outlet channels (newsstands / newsagents)

entries.heading: Retailer exception
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales other than through designated retailer(s), which must be identified or named in the <SalesOutlet> composite

entries.heading: Except to subscription services
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies other than to organizations or services offering consumers subscription access to a catalog of books

entries.heading: To subscription services only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies to organizations or services offering consumers subscription access to a catalog of books

entries.heading: Except through online retail
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales other than through online retail channels

entries.heading: Through online retail only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to sales through online retail channels

entries.heading: Except to schools
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies other than to schools. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Through Inventoryless POD
entries.note: POD copies may be manufactured at any time, either to fulfill a customer order immediately or to replace a minimal stockholding (ie near-inventoryless). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Through Stock Protection POD
entries.note: POD copies may be manufactured only to fulfill a customer order immediately while out of stock and awaiting delivery of further stock from the supplier. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Except through POD
entries.note: Not eligible for POD. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Except to some subscription services
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to all supplies through retailers, and to streaming via the designated subscription services, which must be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Subscription service exclusive
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies to the designated subscription service(s), which must be identified or named in an instance of the <SalesOutlet> composite. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: To education only
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies to educational institutions only (primary, secondary, tertiary, adult, vocational and professional etc). Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Except to education
entries.note: Sales rights (or market distribution rights) apply to supplies other than to educational institutions. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: No restrictions on sales
entries.note: Positive indication that no sales restrictions apply, for example to indicate the product may be sold both online and in bricks-and mortar retail, or to subscription services and non-subscription customers. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Habilitationsschrift
entries.note: Professorial dissertation (thesis for postdoctoral lecturing qualification)

entries.heading: Dissertationsschrift
entries.note: Doctoral thesis

entries.heading: Staatsexamensarbeit
entries.note: State examination thesis

entries.heading: Magisterarbeit
entries.note: Magisters degree thesis

entries.heading: Diplomarbeit
entries.note: Diploma degree thesis

entries.heading: Bachelorarbeit
entries.note: Bachelors degree thesis

entries.heading: Masterarbeit
entries.note: Masters degree thesis

entries.heading: Publisher’s corporate website
entries.note: See also codes 17 and 18

entries.heading: Publisher’s website for a specified work
entries.note: A publisher’s informative and/or promotional webpage relating to a specified work (book, journal, online resource or other publication type)

entries.heading: Online hosting service home page
entries.note: A webpage giving access to an online content hosting service as a whole

entries.heading: Journal home page
entries.note: A webpage giving general information about a serial, in print or electronic format or both

entries.heading: Online resource ‘available content’ page
entries.note: A webpage giving direct access to the content that is available via an online hosting service for a specified product or resource. Generally used for content available online under subscription terms, for courseware etc

entries.heading: Contributor’s own website
entries.note: A webpage maintained by an author or other contributor about their publications and personal background

entries.heading: Publisher’s website relating to specified contributor
entries.note: A publisher’s webpage devoted to a specific author or other contributor

entries.heading: Other publisher’s website relating to specified contributor
entries.note: A webpage devoted to a specific author or other contributor, and maintained by a publisher other than the publisher of the item described in the ONIX record

entries.heading: Third-party website relating to specified contributor
entries.note: A webpage devoted to a specific author or other contributor, and maintained by a third party (eg a fan site)

entries.heading: Contributor’s own website for specified work
entries.note: A webpage maintained by an author or other contributor and specific to an individual work

entries.heading: Other publisher’s website relating to specified work
entries.note: A webpage devoted to an individual work, and maintained by a publisher other than the publisher of the item described in the ONIX record

entries.heading: Third-party website relating to specified work
entries.note: A webpage devoted to an individual work, and maintained by a third party (eg a fan site)

entries.heading: Contributor’s own website for group or series of works
entries.note: A webpage maintained by an author or other contributor and specific to a group or series of works

entries.heading: Publisher’s website relating to group or series of works
entries.note: A publisher’s webpage devoted to a group or series of works

entries.heading: Other publisher’s website relating to group or series of works
entries.note: A webpage devoted to a group or series of works, and maintained by a publisher other than the publisher of the item described in the ONIX record

entries.heading: Third-party website relating to group or series of works (eg a fan site)
entries.note: A webpage devoted to a group or series of works, and maintained by a third party (eg a fan site)

entries.heading: Publisher’s B2B website
entries.note: Use instead of code 01 to specify a publisher’s website for trade users

entries.heading: Publisher’s B2C website
entries.note: Use instead of code 01 to specify a publisher’s website for end customers (consumers)

entries.heading: Author blog
entries.note: For example, a Blogger or Tumblr URL, a Wordpress website or other blog URL

entries.heading: Web page for author presentation / commentary
Web page for full content
entries.note: Use this value in the <Website> composite (typically within <Publisher> or <SupplyDetail>) when sending a link to a webpage at which a digital product is available for download and/or online access

entries.heading: Web page for other commentary / discussion
entries.note: For example a subscribable podcast hosting site, social media message, newsletter issue, other commentary

entries.heading: Transfer-URL
entries.note: URL needed by the German National Library for direct access, harvesting and storage of an electronic resource

entries.heading: DOI Website Link
entries.note: Link needed by German Books in Print (VLB) for DOI registration and ONIX DOI conversion

entries.heading: Supplier’s corporate website
entries.note: A corporate website operated by a distributor or other supplier (not the publisher)

entries.heading: Supplier’s B2B website
entries.note: A website operated by a distributor or other supplier (not the publisher) and aimed at trade customers

entries.heading: Supplier’s B2C website
entries.note: A website operated by a distributor or other supplier (not the publisher) and aimed at consumers

entries.heading: Supplier’s website for a specified work
entries.note: A distributor or supplier’s webpage describing a specified work

entries.heading: Supplier’s B2B website for a specified work
entries.note: A distributor or supplier’s webpage describing a specified work, and aimed at trade customers

entries.heading: Supplier’s B2C website for a specified work
entries.note: A distributor or supplier’s webpage describing a specified work, and aimed at consumers

entries.heading: Supplier’s website for a group or series of works
entries.note: A distributor or supplier’s webpage describing a group or series of works

entries.heading: URL of full metadata description
entries.note: For example an ONIX or MARC record for the product, available online

entries.heading: Social networking URL for specific work or product
entries.note: For example, a Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, Pinterest, Tiktok (including Booktok), Twitter (latterly, X) or similar URL for the product or work

entries.heading: Author’s social networking URL
entries.note: For example, a Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, Pinterest, Tiktok (including Booktok), Twitter (latterly, X) or similar page for the contributor

entries.heading: Publisher’s social networking URL
entries.note: For example, a Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, Pinterest, Tiktok (including Booktok), Twitter (latterly, X) or similar page

entries.heading: Social networking URL for specific article, chapter or content item
entries.note: For example, a Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, Pinterest, Tiktok (including Booktok), Twitter (latterly, X) or similar page. Use only in the context of a specific content item (eg within <ContentItem>)

entries.heading: Publisher’s or third party website for permissions requests
entries.note: For example, a service offering click-through licensing of extracts

entries.heading: Publisher’s or third party website for privacy statement
entries.note: For example, a page providing details related to GDPR. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Publisher’s website for digital preservation
entries.note: The URL of the publisher’s preservation service, or a more specific URL for access to its preservation metadata, to provide confirmation of the preservation status of the product. <WebsiteDescription> may contain the name of the service. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Third-party website for digital preservation
entries.note: The URL of the preservation service (eg https://clockss.org), or a more specific URL for access to its preservation metadata, to provide confirmation of the preservation status of the product. <WebsiteDescription> may contain the name of the service. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Product website for environmental responsibility statement
entries.note: The URL of a web page describing the environmental and sustainability policy, or carbon neutrality status, that applies to the specific product. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Organization’s website for environmental responsibility statement
entries.note: The URL of a web page describing the environmental and sustainability policies, carbon neutrality status, etc of the organization (publisher, supplier etc). For environmental sustainability of the product itself, see List 79. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Legal deposit website for digital preservation
entries.note: The URL of a digital legal deposit service (eg https://www.legaldeposit.org.uk), or a more specific URL for access to its preservation metadata, to provide confirmation of the digital legal deposit status of the product. <WebsiteDescription> may contain the name of the service. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Publisher’s or third party contact form
entries.note: For example, a web page providing an interactive contact form for safety-related issues. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Organization’s website for corporate social responsibility
entries.note: The URL of a web page describing the CSR policies, including corporate ethics, governance and human rights or modern slavery statements, of the organization, but see code 50 for sustainability. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Website for Indigenous statement or resource
entries.note: The URL of a web page providing a statement, protocol or resource relevant to indigenous publishing. This may include content hosted by the publisher, a contributor, or a third party. Examples include Reconciliation Action Plans (RAPs), Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property (ICIP) acknowledgements, cultural protocols, author guidelines, nation, community, or language resources, or contextual references such as Indigenous place names, territories, or treaties (eg native-land.ca). May be used at either organisational or product level, and additional specifics about the web page should be provided using <WebsiteDescription>. Only for use in ONIX 3.0 or later

entries.heading: Link to third-party certification of absence of AI-generated content
entries.note: Use within <Contributor> or <Publisher> as appropriate. Use <WebsiteDescription> to include name of the certification scheme, eg ‘Human Authored’ or ‘Proudly Human certified’. <WebsiteLink> must link directly to certification that the product or work is entirely human-created (within the specific limits of the certification scheme, which may allow de minimis use of generative AI in initial ideation, research or spell-checking). Certified products should carry the certification scheme logo

entries.heading: Link to first-party declaration of absence of AI-generated content
entries.note: Use within <Contributor> or <Publisher> as appropriate. <WebsiteDescription> should include ‘Publisher declaration of human authorship’ or similar. <WebsiteLink> must link directly to a declaration that the product or work is entirely human-created (with no more than de minimis use of generative AI in initial ideation, research or spell-checking)
