entries.heading: Message received
entries.note: Message received but not yet parsed (Acknowledgement must contain neither <MessageStatusDetail> nor <RecordStatusSummary>, and should include <NoProduct/>). There is no particular implication that the acknowledgement message is valid – the status is based solely on receipt of a file and minimal parsing of the original ONIX message header to ascertain <MessageNumber> etc. The Acknowledgement message MAY give a date when parsing is planned

entries.heading: Message rejected
entries.note: Entire original ONIX message rejected (ie NONE of the data records have been ingested). The status of any recognizable records MAY be summarized in the remainder of the Acknowledgement Message

entries.heading: Message part-processed
entries.note: Original ONIX message partially parsed (ie at least SOME of the data records have been ingested, in whole or in part). Records processed to date MUST be summarized in the remainder of the Acknowledgement Message

entries.heading: Message processed
entries.note: Original ONIX message parsed and processed in full, and at least SOME of the data records have been ingested, in whole or in part), Results MUST be summarized in the remainder of the Acknowledgement Message

entries.heading: Ingest date
entries.note: Expected or actual date of processing and ingestion of data to recipient’s system

entries.heading: Export date
entries.note: Expected or actual date for data to be available from the recipient’s system to downstream supply chain partners (or where the recipient is a retailer, to consumers)

entries.heading: Proprietary status detail code type
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required for proprietary status detail codes

entries.heading: ONIX Status detail code
entries.note: Status detail code is taken from List 225

entries.heading: Unclassifiable
entries.note: Use ONLY if the message severity cannot be determined (eg with a legacy system unable to provide detailed error codes)

entries.heading: Info
entries.note: For information only, provided to encourage the ONIX data supplier to improve the quality of their data (eg provision of a non-mandatory data element that is currently missing, better conformity with best practice, etc)

entries.heading: Query
entries.note: Request for clarification or further detail of the meaning of the data provided

entries.heading: Warning
entries.note: The ONIX data has been accepted as provided, but there may be issues in the way it is supplied

entries.heading: Error
entries.note: Some data in an ONIX data element or message structure caused an error due to not meeting the requirements of the standard. The data in question has been rejected, but processing of the remaining elements in the record (or the remain records in the message, if used within <MessageStatusDetail>) has continued

entries.heading: Fatal error
entries.note: Some data in an ONIX data element or message structure caused an unrecoverable error due to not meeting the requirements of the standard. The entire ONIX record has been rejected (or the entire message, if used within <MessageStatusDetail>)

entries.heading: No record errors
entries.note: Entire record parsed and ingested without errors, record may have a Product record in the Acknowledgement which itself may have a <RecordStatusNote> or <RecordStatusDetail> to convey information, editorial queries or warnings

entries.heading: No record errors – errors in collateral
entries.note: Entire record parsed and ingested without errors, record MUST have a Product record in the Acknowledgement with a <RecordStatusNote> or at least one <RecordStatusDetail> to convey errors in associated media files (and possibly supplementary editorial queries)

entries.heading: Record with errors
entries.note: Record parsed and ingested with errors, record MUST have a Product record in the Acknowledgement with a <RecordStatusNote> or at least one <RecordStatusDetail> to convey errors (and possibly supplementary information, editorial queries or warnings). At least SOME of the data in the original Product record has been ingested. There may also be errors in associated media files

entries.heading: Record rejected
entries.note: Entire record rejected, record MUST have a Product record in the Acknowledgement, with a <RecordStatusNote> or at least one <RecordStatusDetail> to convey errors (and possibly supplementary information, editorial queries or warnings). NONE of the data in the original Product record has been ingested

entries.heading: Reported previously
entries.note: Record status reported in an earlier Acknowledgement message, based on partial processing of ONIX message. The record MUST NOT have a Product record in this Acknowledgement. Code not valid in <RecordStatusDetail>

entries.heading: Proprietary grant ID scheme
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary grant identifiers

entries.heading: DOI
entries.note: Digital Object Identifier (variable length and character set, beginning ‘10.’ and without https://doi.org/ or the older http://dx.doi.org/)

entries.heading: Unknown or unspecified
entries.note: Provides positive indication that the gender is not known or is not specified by the sender for any reason

entries.heading: No price-specific constraints
entries.note: Allows positive indication that there are no additional constraints (other than those specified in <EpubUsageConstraint>). By convention, use 01 in <PriceConstraintStatus>

entries.heading: Preview
entries.note: Preview before purchase. Allows a retail customer, account holder or patron to view or listen to a proportion of the book before purchase. Also applies to borrowers making use of ‘acquisition on demand’ models in libraries, and to ‘subscription’ models where the purchase is made on behalf of the reader. Generally used here to specify different preview percentages across different customer types. Note that any Sales embargo date (in <PublishingDate> or <MarketDate>) also applies to provision of previews, unless an explicit date is provided for the preview

entries.heading: Print
entries.note: Make physical copy of extract

entries.heading: Copy / paste
entries.note: Make digital copy of extract

entries.heading: Lend
entries.note: Lendable by the purchaser to another device owner or account holder or patron, eg ‘Lend-to-a-friend’, or library lending (where the library product has a separate <ProductIdentifier> from the consumer product – but for this prefer code 16). The ‘primary’ copy becomes unusable while the secondary copy is ‘lent’ unless a number of concurrent borrowers is also specified

entries.heading: Time-limited license
entries.note: E-publication license is time-limited. Use with code 02 from List 146 and either a time period in days, weeks or months in <PriceConstraintLimit>, or a Valid until date in <PriceConstraintLimit>. The purchased copy becomes unusable when the license expires. For clarity, a perpetual license is the default, but may be specified explicitly with code 01 from list 146, or with code 02 and a limit <Quantity> of 0 days

entries.heading: Library loan renewal
entries.note: Maximum number of consecutive loans or loan extensions (usually from a library) to a single device owner or account holder or patron. Note that a limit of 1 indicates that a loan cannot be renewed or extended

entries.heading: Multi-user license
entries.note: E-publication license is multi-user. Maximum number of concurrent users licensed to use the product should be given in <PriceConstraintLimit>. For clarity, unlimited concurrency is the default, but may be specified explicitly with code 01 from list 146, or with code 02 and a limit <Quantity> of 0 users

entries.heading: Preview on premises
entries.note: Preview locally before purchase. Allows a retail customer, account holder or patron to view a proportion of the book (or the whole book, if no proportion is specified) before purchase, but ONLY while located physically in the retailer’s store (eg while logged on to the store wifi). Also applies to borrowers making use of ‘acquisition on demand’ models in libraries

entries.heading: Text and data mining
entries.note: Make use of the content of the product (text, images, audio etc) or the product metadata or supporting resources for extraction of useful (and possibly new) information through automated computer analysis, or for training of tools for such analysis (including training of generative AI models). By convention, use 01 or 03 in <EpubUsageStatus>. Note 03 should be regarded as ‘prohibited to the full extent allowed by law’, or otherwise expressly reserved by the rightsholder, as in some jurisdictions, TDM may be subject to copyright exception (eg for not-for-profit purposes), subject to optional reservation, or allowed under ‘fair use’ doctrine

entries.heading: TDM for AI to enhance the private purchase experience
entries.note: Where text and data mining is prohibited or otherwise expressly reserved by the rightsholder, make use of the content of the product (text, images, audio etc) or the product metadata or supporting resources to train or enable a generative AI-enhanced purchase experience for a customer, with no use outside of a private AI instance controlled by the reseller – for example to provide AI-assisted book selection

entries.heading: TDM for AI to enhance the private reading experience
entries.note: Where text and data mining is prohibited or otherwise expressly reserved by the rightsholder, make use of the content of the product (text, images, audio etc) or the product metadata or supporting resources to train or enable a generative AI-enhanced reading experience for the purchaser, with no use outside of a private AI instance controlled by the reseller or embedded in the product itself – for example to provide AI-enhanced reading

entries.heading: Library loan
entries.note: Loanable by the purchaser (usually a library) to other device owner or account holder or patron, eg library lending (whether or not the library product has a separate <ProductIdentifier> from the consumer product). The ‘primary’ copy becomes unusable while the secondary copy is ‘on loan’ unless a number of concurrent borrowers is also specified. Use code 08 to specify any limit on loan renewals

entries.note: Preschool and kindergarten

entries.note: Professional qualifications

entries.heading: Return authorization contact
entries.note: Eg for use where authorization must be gained from the supplier (distributor or wholesaler)

entries.heading: Product safety contact
entries.note: Eg for EU General product safety regulation (GPSR) compliance where the supplier acts on behalf of the publisher or publisher representative as an importer into the EU. See https://commission.europa.eu/business-economy-euro/product-safety-and-requirements/product-safety/general-product-safety-regulation_en

entries.heading: Product raw materials contact
entries.note: Eg for EU Deforestation regulation (EUDR) compliance where the supplier acts on behalf of the publisher or publisher representative as an importer into the EU. See https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32023R1115&qid=1687867231461

entries.heading: Customer services contact
entries.note: For general enquiries

entries.heading: Audiovisual work
entries.note: A complete audiovisual work which is published as a content item in a product which carries two or more such works, eg when two or three AV works are published in a single omnibus package

entries.heading: Front matter
entries.note: Audiovisual components such as a scene index or introduction which appear before the main content of the product

entries.heading: Body matter
entries.note: Audiovisual components such as scenes or ‘chapters’ which appear as part of the main body of the AV material in the product

entries.heading: End matter
entries.note: Audiovisual components such as advertising which appear after the main content of the product

entries.heading: Proprietary AV Item ID scheme
entries.note: For example, a publisher’s own identifier. Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary AV item identifiers

entries.heading: GTIN-13
entries.note: Formerly known as the EAN-13 (unhyphenated)

entries.heading: DOI
entries.note: Digital Object Identifier (variable length and character set, beginning ‘10.’ and without https://doi.org/ or the older http://dx.doi.org/)

entries.heading: IMDB
entries.note: Motion picture work identifier from the International Movie Database

entries.heading: ISRC
entries.note: International Standard Recording Code, 5 alphanumeric characters plus 7 digits

entries.heading: ISAN
entries.note: International Standard Audiovisual Number (17 or 26 characters – 16 or 24 hexadecimal digits, plus one or two alphanumeric check characters, and without spaces or hyphens)

entries.heading: EIDR Content ID
entries.note: Entertainment Identifier Registry identifier for an audiovisual work, eg a movie, TV series (a DOI beginning ‘10.5240/’ with a suffix of 21 hexadecimal digits and five hyphens, and without https://doi.org/ or the older http://dx.doi.org/). See ui.eidr.org/search

entries.heading: Batteries not required
entries.note: No electronics included. The default if battery type and safety information is omitted

entries.heading: Batteries built in
entries.note: Batteries built in or pre-installed in product, non-user replaceable. May use <ProductFormFeatureDescription> to provide further details

entries.heading: Batteries pre-installed
entries.note: Batteries pre-installed, user replaceable. Use <ProductFormFeatureDescription> to provide further details, eg ‘2 x 1.2V LR6 / AA rechargeable’, with these details formatted as [integer] x [number]V [type or descriptive text] and usually taken from the outer packaging

entries.heading: Batteries supplied
entries.note: Batteries included with the product, but not pre-installed. Use <ProductFormFeatureDescription> to provide further details, eg ‘2 x 1.2V LR6 / AA rechargeable’, with these details formatted as [integer] x [number]V [type or descriptive text] and usually taken from the outer packaging

entries.heading: Batteries required
entries.note: Batteries required for use, but not supplied with the product. May use <ProductFormFeatureDescription> to provide further details, eg ‘2 x 1.2V LR6 / AA rechargeable’, with these details formatted as [integer] x [number]V [type or descriptive text] and usually taken from the outer packaging

entries.heading: Batteries supplied spare
entries.note: Spare batteries included with product, in addition to those specified using codes 02 or 03. May use <ProductFormFeatureDescription> to provide further details

entries.heading: Safety data sheet available
entries.note: (Material) Safety Data Sheet available for the product (including its batteries). <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must be used to supply URL of documentation

entries.heading: Technical data sheet available
entries.note: Battery manufacturer’s technical data sheet available. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must be used to supply URL of documentation

entries.heading: Rechargeable
entries.note: Independent of whether charger is supplied as part of the product. Note that this is largely dependent on battery chemistry, but should be specified separately to avoid ambiguity

entries.heading: Battery warning text
entries.note: <ProductFormFeatureDescription> contains battery safety-related warning text, generally taken from the outer packaging (eg ‘Warning – internal battery: product must not be pierced’)

entries.heading: Battery chemistry
entries.note: <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must provide details of the battery chemistry (eg ‘Sodium-Sulfur’). Use ONLY where no suitable code exists for the specific chemistry used

entries.heading: Lithium-ion
entries.note: For all specific battery chemistries, <ProductFormFeatureDescription> may optionally describe the battery construction – for example the number of individual cells per battery and any other physical details, eg ‘4 x pouch cells’

entries.heading: Zinc-Manganese dioxide
entries.note: ‘Alkaline battery’

entries.heading: Zinc-Carbon
entries.note: Common ‘dry cell’ battery

entries.heading: WEEE waste
entries.note: No batteries are required or included with the product, possibly because it is externally powered, but the product may nonetheless qualify as Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) upon disposal. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> may contain a brief description of the electrical or electronic components that form a part of the product. Note that presence of any battery information except code 00 indicates the product may be subject to WEEE regulation, and this code need not be included unless a description is needed

entries.heading: Battery safety warning text
entries.note: Exact text of warning must be included in <ProductFormFeatureDescription>

entries.heading: Battery description
entries.note: <ProductFormFeatureDescription> may contain a full description of the batteries supplied (chemistry, cell structure, battery size and weight, number, capacity etc). Use ONLY if the product (or a product part) contains multiple different TYPES of battery that cannot be described with existing codes (eg a mix of battery chemistries or batteries of different sizes, within a single product part)

entries.heading: Inapplicable
entries.note: The product is not classed as dangerous goods. The default if information is omitted

entries.heading: GHS
entries.note: Indicates if the product is generally classed as a hazardous substance. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain a Hazard Class [eg “Irritant (Category 2)”] using the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/danger/publi/ghs/ghs_rev08/ST-SG-AC10-30-Rev8e.pdf – Annex 1 contains a list of hazard classes and categories). The text is usually available on the Safety Data Sheet, along with equivalent GHS Hazard Pictograms, and may also be on the product or packaging. Must be accompanied by a Safety Data Sheet URL (see code 06), and is usually accompanied by one or more of codes 02–05 listing the specific chemical hazard

entries.heading: Transport
entries.note: Indicates the product is classed as a hazardous substance for transportation purposes. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain a ‘UN number’ (or UNID, ‘UN’ plus four digits from the list of at http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/danger/publi/unrec/English/index.pdf) specifying the specific chemical hazard, eg UN1203 is gasoline

entries.heading: Storage
entries.note: Indicates the product is classed as a hazardous substance for storage purposes. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain a ‘UN number’ (or UNID, ‘UN’ plus four digits from the list of at http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/danger/publi/unrec/English/index.pdf) specifying the specific chemical hazard, eg UN1203 is gasoline

entries.heading: Waste
entries.note: Indicates the product is classed as a hazardous substance for disposal purposes. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain a ‘UN number’ (or UNID, ‘UN’ plus four digits from the list of at http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/danger/publi/unrec/English/index.pdf) specifying the specific chemical hazard, eg UN1203 is gasoline

entries.heading: Other
entries.note: Indicates the product is classed as a hazardous substance for purposes not covered by other codes. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain a ‘UN number’ (or UNID, ‘UN’ plus four digits from the list of at http://www.unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/danger/publi/unrec/English/index.pdf) specifying the specific chemical hazard, eg UN1203 is gasoline. Must be accompanied by a Safety Data Sheet URL (see code 06)

entries.heading: Safety data sheet available
entries.note: (Material) Safety Data Sheet available for the product. <ProductFormFeatureDescription> must contain the URL of documentation

entries.heading: Proprietary event ID scheme
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary event identifiers

entries.heading: Cancelled
entries.note: Abandoned after having previously been announced

entries.heading: Date of occurrence
entries.note: Date and (with the default dateformat) time the event occurrence begins

entries.heading: Date of occurrence end
entries.note: Date and (with the default dateformat) time the event occurrence ends

entries.heading: 44.1kHz
entries.note: 44,100 samples per channel per second (CD quality)

entries.heading: 16-bits per sample
entries.note: Bit depth, 16 bits per sample (CD-quality)

entries.heading: ID3v1
entries.note: Includes v1.1

entries.heading: Printed long grain
entries.note: Grain of paper parallel to spine

entries.heading: Printed short grain
entries.note: Grain of paper perpendicular to spine

entries.heading: Printed monochrome
entries.note: Usually B/W

entries.heading: Printed higher-quality CMYK
entries.note: Printed ‘premium’ or high fidelity / high resolution CMYK (where different from ‘Printed CMYK’, and the manufacturer offers two quality settings)

entries.heading: Printed with bleed
entries.note: At least some content bleeds to or beyond trimmed page edge

entries.heading: Printed higher-quality monochrome
entries.note: Printed ‘premium’ or high fidelity / high resolution monochrome (where different from ‘Printed monochrome’, and the manufacturer offers two quality settings)

entries.heading: Filename
entries.note: Specification Feature Value carries the filename of the final product

entries.heading: Audio loudness
entries.note: Specification Feature Value is the target loudness in LKFS (LUFS) used for audio normalization – see ITU-R BS.1770

entries.heading: Paper type
entries.note: Specification Feature Description is the paper or card type, eg Coated, uncoated

entries.heading: Paper weight
entries.note: Specification Feature Value is the paper or card weight in GSM

entries.heading: Paper color
entries.note: Specification Feature Value is the paper or card color code selected from List 257

entries.heading: Ink color(s)
entries.note: Specification Feature Description lists the ink color(s) required. Do not use if mono or conventional CMYK

entries.heading: Special finish
entries.note: Specification Feature Value lists a special finish required, from List 258

entries.heading: Proprietary resource ID scheme
entries.note: For example, a publisher’s internal digital asset ID. Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary resource identifiers

entries.heading: ISCC
entries.note: International Standard Content Code, a ‘similarity hash’ derived algorithmically from the resource content itself (see https://iscc.codes). <IDValue> is the ISCC-CODE generated from a digital manifestation of the work, as a variable-length case-insensitive alphanumeric string (or 55 characters including three hyphens if using ISCC v1.0, but this is deprecated). Note alphabetic characters in v1.x ISCCs use Base32 encoding and are conventionally upper case. The ‘ISCC:’ prefix is omitted

entries.heading: Cover
entries.note: Artwork for printing a case or card cover

entries.heading: Jacket
entries.note: Artwork for printing a paper dust jacket

entries.heading: Mono
entries.note: Includes ‘stereo’ where channels are identical

entries.heading: 44.1kHz
entries.note: 44,100 samples per channel per second (CD-quality)

entries.heading: 16-bits per sample
entries.note: Bit depth, 16 bits per sample (CD-quality)

entries.heading: Stereo
entries.note: Includes ‘joint stereo’

entries.heading: ID3v1
entries.note: Includes v1.1

entries.heading: Surround 4.1
entries.note: Five-channel audio (including low-frequency channel)

entries.heading: Surround 5.1
entries.note: Six-channel audio (including low-frequency channel)

entries.heading: Without crop marks
entries.note: If page size of the resource file is not equal to final trimmed page size of the product (in <Measure>, then text or image area should be centered on final pages. Note that content may not bleed to the trimmed page edge

entries.heading: Preseparated – 2 channels
entries.note: Two pages in the resource file represent a single page in the product

entries.heading: Preseparated – 4 channels
entries.note: For example, preseparated CMYK

entries.heading: File format
entries.note: Resource File Feature Value carries a code from List 178

entries.heading: Filename
entries.note: Resource File Feature Value carries the filename of the supporting resource, necessary only when it is different from the last part of the path provided in <ResourceFileLink>

entries.heading: Approximate download file size in megabytes
entries.note: Resource File Feature Value carries a decimal number only, suggested no more than 2 or 3 significant digits (eg 1.7, not 1.7462 or 1.75MB)

entries.heading: MD5 hash value
entries.note: MD5 hash value of the resource file. <ResourceFileFeatureValue> should contain the 128-bit digest value (as 32 hexadecimal digits). Can be used as a cryptographic check on the integrity of a resource after it has been retrieved

entries.heading: Exact download file size in bytes
entries.note: Resource File Feature Value carries a integer number only (eg 1831023)

entries.heading: SHA-256 hash value
entries.note: SHA-256 hash value of the resource file. <ResourceFileFeatureValue> should contain the 256-bit digest value (as 64 hexadecimal digits). Can be used as a cryptographic check on the integrity of a resource after it has been retrieved

entries.heading: Audio loudness
entries.note: Resource File Feature Value is the loudness in LKFS (LUFS) used for audio normalization – see ITU-R BS.1770

entries.heading: Last updated
entries.note: Date when a resource was last changed or updated

entries.heading: Available from
entries.note: Date from which a resource is available for download

entries.heading: Available until
entries.note: Date until which a resource is available for download

entries.heading: Adjacent to logical page
entries.note: Insert appears after an even numbered or before an odd numbered logical page. <InsertPointValue> is an integer page number

entries.heading: Adjacent to physical page
entries.note: Insert appears after an even numbered or before an odd numbered printed page number. <InsertPointValue> is an integer page number

entries.heading: At timecode
entries.note: Insert appears in the body at a specific timecode (hours, minutes, seconds, counted from the beginning of the product before any inserts are added). <InsertPointValue> is in the format HHHMMSS. Fill with leading zeroes if any elements are missing. If centisecond precision is required, use HHHMMSScc

entries.heading: Adjacent to HTML label
entries.note: Insert appears before the block-level HTML element – <InsertPointValue> is the value of the id or name attribute of the block-level element (which must be unique within the body of the product)

entries.heading: Image shows product in packaging
entries.note: Image shows retail product only, in packaging

entries.heading: Image shows product (without packaging)
entries.note: Image shows retail product only, without packaging

entries.heading: Image shows product and accessories
entries.note: Image shows product (with or without packaging) and accessory items not included with product

entries.heading: Image shows assembled product
entries.note: Image shows product in final form (eg an assembled toy or model, completed puzzle)

entries.heading: Image shows product in use
entries.note: Image shows product in use by a person or people

entries.heading: Image shows multiple products
entries.note: Image shows multiple copies of the product, or multiple related products

entries.heading: Image shows detail of product
entries.note: Image shows part of product, for example inside pages of a book or detail of part of a toy

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘front’
entries.note: Shows front cover, spine and top edge of pages (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘back’
entries.note: Shows back cover, spine and top edge of pages (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘front foredge’
entries.note: Shows front cover, foredge and top edge of pages (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘back foredge’
entries.note: Shows back cover, foredge and top edge of pages (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘front low’
entries.note: Shows front cover and spine (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘back low’
entries.note: Shows back cover and spine (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘front foredge low’
entries.note: Shows front cover and foredge (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘back foredge low’
entries.note: Shows back cover and foredge (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 2D front
entries.note: Shows front cover only (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 2D back
entries.note: Shows back cover only (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 2D spine
entries.note: Shows spine only (or equivalent for non-book products or packaging)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘horizontal’
entries.note: Product is horizontal (eg lying on table)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘vertical’
entries.note: Product is vertical (eg standing on table)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘open’
entries.note: Product or product packaging is open, showing at least some interior detail (eg of the page content of a book)

entries.heading: 3D perspective ‘closed’
entries.note: Product or product packaging is closed, or no significant interior detail is visible

entries.heading: Overall textured laminate
entries.note: Provide any further details in Specification feature description

entries.heading: Irregular
entries.note: No fixed publication schedule

entries.heading: Regular
entries.note: New products in the collection are regularly scheduled, but less frequently than once every two years

entries.heading: Biennial
entries.note: Once every two years

entries.heading: Annual
entries.note: Yearly

entries.heading: Biannual
entries.note: Twice a year, or once per academic semester

entries.heading: Triannual
entries.note: Three times a year, or once per academic term

entries.heading: Quarterly
entries.note: Four times a year

entries.heading: Bimonthly
entries.note: Six times per year

entries.heading: Monthly
entries.note: Once every month, or approximately twelve times per year

entries.heading: Fortnightly
entries.note: Once every two weeks, or approximately twenty five times per year

entries.heading: Weekly
entries.note: Or approximately fifty times per year

entries.heading: Daily, or more frequently than weekly
entries.note: At least twice a week

entries.heading: No future publications
entries.note: Positive indication that the product is the last to be published in the collection, or that no further publications are planned

entries.heading: Valid from
entries.note: Date on which a license becomes effective

entries.heading: Valid until
entries.note: Date on which a license ceases to be effective

entries.heading: From… until date
entries.note: Combines From date and Until date to define a period (both dates are inclusive). Use for example with dateformat 06

entries.heading: Unclassifiable
entries.note: Use ONLY if the error message severity cannot be determined (eg with a legacy system unable to provide detailed error codes)

entries.heading: Info
entries.note: For information only, provided to encourage the master file supplier to improve the quality of their files (eg to make rendering of the product more reliable / interoperable, or to improve accessibility, etc)

entries.heading: Query
entries.note: Request for clarification or further detail of the meaning of some part of the master file data provided

entries.heading: Warning
entries.note: The master files have been accepted as provided, but there may be issues in the way they were supplied

entries.heading: Error
entries.note: Some data in the content or structure of a master file caused an error due to not meeting the requirements of the relevant standard. The master file in question has been rejected, but processing of the remaining master files comprising the product has continued

entries.heading: Fatal error
entries.note: Some data in the content or structure of a master file caused an unrecoverable error due to not meeting the requirements of the relevant standard. The entire set of master files for the product has been rejected

entries.heading: Blue Angel
entries.note: Product carries – or is eligible to carry – Blue Angel labelling. See https://www.blauer-engel.de

entries.heading: Cradle to Cradle
entries.note: Product carries – or is eligible to carry – C2C labelling. Has bronze, silver, gold and platinum levels. See c2ccertified.org

entries.heading: Nordic Swan
entries.note: See https://www.nordic-swan-ecolabel.org

entries.heading: ClimatePartner
entries.note: See https://www.climatepartner.com/en/take-action/measure-carbon-footprints/product-carbon-footprint-pcf

entries.heading: EU Ecolabel
entries.note: See https://www.ecolabel.eu

entries.heading: ClimateCalc
entries.note: Per book CO₂e calculator, used widely in Denmark and as the basis of the IPA’s Publishing 2030 Accelerator project’s calculator. See https://www.climatecalc.eu and https://sdg.internationalpublishers.org/cop26-accelerator/

entries.heading: Canadian SPT / Green Book Alliance Carbon calculator
entries.note: Per book CO₂e calculator from BookNet Canada, see https://www.booknetcanada.ca/sustainable-publishing-tools and https://www.greenbookalliance.org/carbon-calculator-project

entries.heading: V-Label
entries.note: Indicates the product is certified as vegan (does not use animal products, for example in binding or adhesives). See v-label.com

entries.heading: Proprietary prize ID scheme
entries.note: Note that a distinctive <IDTypeName> is required with proprietary prize identifiers

entries.heading: GND
entries.note: Gemeinsame Normdatei – Joint Authority File in the German-speaking countries. See https://www.dnb.de/DE/Professionell/Standardisierung/GND/gnd_node.html (German) and https://www.dnb.de/EN/Professionell/Standardisierung/GND/gnd_node.html (English)

entries.heading: FAST
entries.note: Faceted Application of Subject Terminology, OCLC subject scheme derived from LCSH. See https://fast.oclc.org/fast/. Codes are up to 8 digits, for example 1430698 for the Booker Prize (see https://id.worldcat.org/fast/1430698)
